Shield Bashing +10%: +10% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Natural Armor +5: Passive: +5 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +40 (Equipment bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Devotion +84: Passive: +84 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Damage Reduction 10/Slashing: Reduces physical damage by 10, except from Slashing attacks.
